item.title: Mountain lion captured in SF neighborhood has long history of encounters with biologists
item.description: The big cat captured in the city's Pac Heights neighborhood is no stranger to Field Biologist Richie King of the Santa Cruz Puma Project, which tracks and studies mountain lions. "I was like, 'it's that same guy,'" King said. "He's still looking for his own little home territory."

item.title: South Bay leaders prepare as fears loom over possible ICE presence at Super Bowl 60
item.description: "They didn't have to do this level of terror." Months ago, the Trump administration said ICE agents would be on the ground in Santa Clara. It's a possibility that South Bay leaders have been preparing for. They want those in the community to know they have their backs.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mainly clear tonight; sunnier and milder this week
item.description: We can expect mainly clear skies tonight with overnight lows ranging from upper 30s in the chilliest inland valleys to low and mid 40s elsewhere.

item.title: Texas man convicted of 2 fatal shootings becomes the 1st person executed in the US this year
item.description: Charles Victor Thompson received a lethal injection Wednesday evening at the state penitentiary in Huntsville, Texas.

item.title: How to spot the difference between authentic and fake Super Bowl LX merchandise
item.description: With the big game just days away, official NFL popup shops are already rolling into the Bay Area. With the expected tens of thousands of visitors descending on the Bay Area next week, officials warn that counterfeiters will be out in full force. Here's what to look out for.

item.title: Is wildlife sighting more common in SF now? Experts explain after mountain lion incident
item.description: Wildlife sightings are becoming more familiar in San Francisco, and experts say it's not necessarily a bad thing.

item.title: Santa Cruz woman falls for gift card scam, but takes quick action and gets her money back
item.description: Scammers convinced a Santa Cruz woman she was in trouble with the law -- but after initially falling for their tricks, the victim managed to recover thousands of what they stole.

item.title: SF changes method to count unhoused; advocate believes it's political, will lead to undercount
item.description: For the first time in more than two decades, San Francisco is changing the way it counts the number of unhoused individuals on its streets.

item.title: Search warrant FBI served at elections office near Atlanta seeks records tied to the 2020 elections
item.description: The search warrant the FBI served at a Fulton County elections office seeks records tied to the 2020 election, officials say.

item.title: Tesla CEO Elon Musk to stop production of models S and X; convert Fremont factory to produce robots
item.description: Tesla's annual profit plunged to its lowest level since the pandemic five years ago. Now, Elon Musk said Tesla would be closing down production of two car models and convert the Fremont, California, factory to produce its Optimus robots.
